context.body: Physical wounds, personal address, blessing, and the Gospel’s stated purpose converge.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The risen Jesus offers Thomas the requested wounds and calls him from unbelief to belief.
observations.label: Thomas addresses Jesus as Lord and God: action

observations.body: Thomas answers, “My Lord and my God”; later readers are invited to believe without seeing.
observations.label: Thomas addresses Jesus as Lord and God: response

observations.body: my Lord · my God · believed · life in his name
observations.label: Words in John 20:24–31

payload.posture: Read John 20:24–31 as jesus and god evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Jesus receives Thomas’s confession without correction, while the Gospel continues to distinguish Jesus from the Father.
payload.title: Thomas addresses Jesus as Lord and God
